writeup: TIC 219765539 is a candidate eclipsing binary star detected in TESS photometry with an orbital period of 1.380873 days and a primary eclipse depth of 0.03% dimming. The automated pipeline identified this system with a detection significance of 17.7 in the box-least-squares search. However, two data quality issues warrant attention: the odd and even eclipses show significantly different depths, which may indicate the true period is double what the initial search found, and the pixel-level centroid offset of 19.0 arcsec places the signal only marginally closer to the target star than to a nearby bright neighbor - within the pipeline's own systematic uncertainty of 0.10-0.3 pixels. The candidate does not appear in six checked variable-star catalogs. No secondary eclipse was detected, and the machine-learning screening score is 0.64 out of 1.0.
